tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dang gur zhal sogs kyi gtor bzlog chig sgrub dang sgrub grogs nyung ngu'i byed tshul bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra kī la ya/ dpal rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog sngags 'chang rgya gar shes rab bzang po'am/ shes rab rgyal mtshan du'ang grags pa de nyid dang / sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnam gnyis kyi gsung bzhin phyag len snga phyi'i khyad bcas dpal sa skyar mdzad srol bzhugs pa bzhin/ dpon slob bzhi grwa lta bus bsgrub rgyu yin na gdab las zor 'phen dang bcas pa'i lag len 'di ltar bya ste/ de yang tshogs kyi bshags pa grub pa dang slob dpon gyi mdun du rdul tshon nam ras bris gang rung gi mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i dkyil du 'brub khung gru gsum nag po me ris can gyi nang dgra bgegs kyi sa bon ṇi ṭi zhes pa'am/ nṛ tṛ gang rung 'dam ka yin pas ṇi'am/ nṛ ljang gu/ ṭi'am tṛ ser po brtsegs ma'am thad bris can bkram khar lcags slangs nang gi sgrub ling rnams bzhag 'di dag rgyun du dgug gzhug grub nas gtor ma'i mdun dang dgug gzhug skabs bcas la sder stegs lta bu'i khar 'jog pa ni ling snod la rdog rdul 'gos dogs yin pas ling snod 'og tu gding rgyu de nges par rgyab mdun ma nor ba dgos shing / ras dang rdul tshon 'brub khung steng ling snod las gdan gzhan mi dgos/ gang ltar de'i mthar yang 'brel so drug dang gdab kha drug gi chas rnams bsham/ slob dpon grogs bcas stan la 'dug bzhin du mchod g.yog pas phud dam phor bzung la gser skyems bskor 'chams bcas rig 'dzin bskor 'chams med/ phur kha bsgyur ba nas bzung slob dpon 'dug bzhin du 'chams tshul dang yang 'brel so drug gi rdzas so sor ling gar 'debs pa bsgral mchod dngos bai ḍūr+ya sngon po sogs/ phyi nang gsang ba rnams bya/

lhag ma gtong ba'am/ mi gtong ba gang rung dam ye phral ba nas zor bskul mjug gi dgu brdung rdzogs pa dang bdud rgyal bskul gyi dbyangs tshugs/ dam tshig chen po'i mjug gi dgu brdung rdzogs pa dang bzhi brdung dgu brdung spel ba bzlog pa'i dzam 'gros rol mo tshar gsum sogs byas mthar chems brdung yun ci rigs ring ling ro gtor ma rnams phyir 'gror bcug la sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes rol mo bzhag de nas slob dpon rdor dril gsor bkrol/ gzhan rnams phud dam sogs khur 'os yod pa'am med kyang rung kī la ya bzla bzhin pas thams cad zor 'phen pa der slebs pa dang / gtor ma rnams bsgrigs/ bcom dril byas la bdud rgyal bskul chung / bdag sho sa bdag rnams kyi bskul sde tshan re re'i mthar dril gsil slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas phud chang bzung la gser skyems byin brlabs grub nas bcom dril rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum gyi sku thog la bskang ba dang bstod dbyangs dril gsil gyi mdzad srol yod par bshad pas rigs 'gre sbyar na/ 'dir yang rung bas/ bla ma rig 'dzin gyi dbyangs la tshigs rkang re'i mtshams su dril gsil/ grub gnyis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol la dril gsil gser skyems gtor/ de phyin dbyangs med rnams la rol mo len mtshams su dril gsil re gser skyems steng 'og bar gsum du 'thor skabs dril bu tal mar gsil/ dpang gzugs 'gor bcom dril rol mo len mtshams su dril gsil 'og ma kun la 'gre/ zor lam dbye bar slob dpon gyis rdor dril mda' gzhu bzung la mda'i zor lam dbye tshul dril gsil skabs g.yas kyis rdo rje mda' gzhu kun bzung / zor bskul gyi tshe sgrub grogs zhig la rdor dril gtad la rang nyid mda' gzhu thogs nas gtor drung du rang 'gros kyis song la zor rnams 'phen ring sgrub grogs rnams kyis kī la ya bzla zhing rdor dril yod pa des gsol dkrol byas la/

'phen grub nas yar lam gtor gnon rgyun bzhin gtor 'bul phyi nang gang rung du bstan skyong bcas phul la rjes chog bya/ yar 'byor nas lhag ma rgyas par mdzad srol yang sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can yan la byung / de man deng sang phyag len la mdzad pa ltar bsgral mchod grub nas dam ye gshegs gong mdzad pa 'phros don dang / yang rang nyid chig sgrub rnga sbug can nang rnga rkyang gang ltar na'ang gdab chas rnams gong bzhin bshams/ phud phor steng la bkod brje mtshams rnams su sgrub g.yog gis ster la bshams/ rig 'dzin bskul dang phur kha bsgyur bar rnga rol las lag cha med pas phur kha bsgyur ba'i chems brdung rjes kyi gsum brdeg len can byas la rdor dril dgug gzhug rnga rol hod kyis blangs la chems brdung dgu brdung / lha srung spyan 'dren nas lha dbye'i spos bdug bar rnga rol rgyun bzhin/ lha dbye'i 'phyong gi dgu brdung rdzogs pa dang rnga rol bzhag nas spos bdug hod kyis rnga rol len pa 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre/ gnas nas dgug pa nas bzung rdul du rlog pa'i bar liṅga rdzas 'phen rigs rnga rol bzhag yang hod kyis blangs nas bskul bya/ zhal du bstabs pa la chems brdung thog sngags brjod pa las phyag rgya mi dgos shing / de'i mjug gi gsum brdeg len can grub nas rnga rol bzhag dgug gzhug rdor dril rnga rol hod kyis blangs nas bsgral mchod rol tshig bskul/ rnga rol bzhag nas phur 'debs/ de bzhin ral gri/ thun tho ba 'debs pa rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ bsgral mchod grub nas ling ro gtor drung bzhag la bai ḍūr+ya sngon po/ phyi nang gsang ba rnams rnga rol thogs nas bya/ gzhan gong bzhin la gtor gnon skabs gdangs dang lag bsnol med par rdor dril lag stabs gang bdes bzung ste/ tshigs bcad shur mar g.yas bskor ci rigs/ sngags shur mar g.yon bskor gcig las mi thebs gzhan 'dra'o//
